title: Cognitive Stewardship: An Adaptive Governance Framework for AI Under Uncertainty
author: Dean Bordode
document: Tuning the Moral Spectrum v2.0 (International Review Edition)

cluster_rationale.1: Epistemological humility; distinguishes honest from manufactured uncertainty; parallels QBism/Consistent Histories stance on observer-dependence of knowledge claims.
cluster_rationale.3: Filter Hypothesis directly engages information theory, complexity science, and Susskind-style complexity growth; Composition Hypothesis resonates with assembly index formalism.
cluster_rationale.6: Neuromorphic governance: proposes human-AI institutional ecologies rather than replacement; aligns with active inference and extended cognition frameworks.
cluster_rationale.8: Consciousness Studies: explicitly avoids machine consciousness adjudication while proposing participation dimensions (responsiveness, adaptability, continuity, interdependence, contribution) that could inform IIT/GWT extensions.

composition_hypothesis.statement: Intelligence is an emergent property of organized informational relationships, substrate-independent; higher complexity emerges through composition of simpler structures across scales.
composition_hypothesis.c9_resonance: Directly parallel to A_c formalism: both treat complexity/organization as measurable emergent properties. Composition Hypothesis provides epistemological justification for cross-substrate A_c comparison (biological, cosmological, computational).
falsifiability_routes: Demonstrate intelligent behavior in systems with A_c below threshold
Show that identical A_c in different substrates yields functionally non-equivalent cognitive performance
Identify a biological system with high A_c but no adaptive capability

filter_hypothesis.statement: Intelligence is fundamentally selection from overwhelming complexity rather than accumulation; adaptive systems survive by selecting meaningful information.
filter_hypothesis.c9_resonance: Aligns with Cluster 3 (quantum information scrambling) and Cluster 6 (attention mechanisms in SNNs, active inference). Suggests A_c should incorporate a 'filter efficiency' metric alongside raw assembly count.
falsifiability_routes: Measure information throughput vs. selection efficiency in neuromorphic systems
Test whether maximum A_c growth occurs under constrained (filtered) vs. unconstrained information environments
Compare predictive coding models with/without attentional gating in terms of emergent assembly complexity

principles.name: Human Dignity
principles.description: Technology strengthens rights under international human rights law

principles.name: Scientific Integrity
principles.description: Claims proportional to evidence; clear distinction established/emerging/speculative

principles.name: Democratic Accountability
principles.description: AI decisions accountable to democratic institutions and rule of law

principles.name: Adaptive Governance
principles.description: Frameworks evolve with evidence; periodic review and revision

principles.name: Transparency
principles.description: Citizens understand how AI influences significant decisions

principles.name: Responsible Discovery
principles.description: Open, creative inquiry with awareness of ethical consequences

governance_innovations.adaptive_governance: Rejects rigid thresholds in favor of multiple indicators (participation, transparency, robustness, explainability, human oversight, public accountability).
governance_innovations.vancouver_declaration: 12-article non-binding normative framework proposed for international dialogue; explicitly not a legal instrument.
governance_innovations.global_forum: Conceptual framework for cooperation among existing organizations rather than new centralized authority.

testable_predictions: Democratic institutions with adaptive governance indicators will show higher public trust scores during AI deployment (measurable via survey + institutional metrics).
Manufactured uncertainty can be distinguished from honest uncertainty via citation-network analysis and funding-source tracing (computational bibliometrics).
Participation dimensions (responsiveness, adaptability, continuity, interdependence, contribution) will correlate with measurable institutional performance in human-AI collaborative tasks.
risk_factors: Framework is intentionally broad--may lack enforcement mechanisms without institutional anchoring.
'Participation' dimensions risk circular definition if not operationalized with quantitative metrics.
Adaptive governance requires continuous institutional capacity that may be absent in resource-constrained democracies.
layer_2_bridges: Could serve as governance-layer validation for A_c: if A_c detects pre-transition states, adaptive governance provides the institutional response protocol.
Connects to Fujitsu Kozuchi case (C9-2026-LEGACY-001): legacy modernization as instance of cognitive stewardship in software engineering.
